-- Flee The Facility Script (WindUI hub for Delta)
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local BEAST_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 60)
local PLAYER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
local COMPUTER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(30, 80, 230)
local COMPUTER_DONE = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
local POD_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(120, 240, 255)
local DOOR_OPEN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
local DOOR_CLOSED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
local EXIT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)

local ARROW_MARGIN = 60

-- Crawl settings
local CRAWL_HEIGHT = 0.9         -- body height above floor (lower = closer to floor)
local CRAWL_ANIM_REF_SPEED = 8   -- animation speed reference (lower = faster limbs)
local CRAWL_SPEED = 8            -- walk speed while crawling

-- Third person camera settings
local THIRD_PERSON_MIN_ZOOM = 0.5   -- lets you zoom all the way in
local THIRD_PERSON_MAX_ZOOM = 40    -- how far out you can zoom
local THIRD_PERSON_START_ZOOM = 12  -- how far out the camera starts

-- Light settings (soft glow around you)
local LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS = 0.8      -- raise for brighter, lower for dimmer
local LIGHT_RANGE = 45            -- how far the light reaches (studs)
local LIGHT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 225)

local flags = {
    Players = false,
    Computers = false,
    Pods = false,
    Doors = false,
    ExitDoors = false,
    BeastAlert = false,
    ThirdPerson = false,
    Light = false,
    NoFail = false,
}
local running = true
local currentBeast = nil

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function rs(name)
    local v = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
    return v and v.Value
end

local function stat(plr, name)
    local folder = plr:FindFirstChild("TempPlayerStatsModule", true)
    local v = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
    return v and v.Value
end

local function notify(title, text, duration)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title,
            Text = text,
            Duration = duration or 6,
        })
    end)
end

local function makeHighlight(adornee, name)
    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = name
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Adornee = adornee
    hl.Parent = adornee
    return hl
end

local function setColor(hl, color)
    hl.FillColor = color
    hl.OutlineColor = color
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WINDOW
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local themeName = "Dark"
pcall(function()
    WindUI:AddTheme({
        Name = "Midnight",
        Accent = Color3.fromHex("#00E5FF"),
        Dialog = Color3.fromHex("#0B0B12"),
        Outline = Color3.fromHex("#00E5FF"),
        Text = Color3.fromHex("#FFFFFF"),
        Placeholder = Color3.fromHex("#8A8A9E"),
        Background = Color3.fromHex("#07070C"),
        Button = Color3.fromHex("#00FF6A"),     -- toggle ON = bright green
        Toggle = Color3.fromHex("#00FF6A"),
        ToggleBar = Color3.fromHex("#B8B8C4"),  -- toggle OFF = light gray
        Icon = Color3.fromHex("#FFFFFF"),
    })
end)

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Flee The Facility Script",
    Icon = "gavel",
    Author = "Discord: antho.nyx",
    Folder = "FTFScript",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 400),
    Theme = themeName,
})

pcall(function()
    Window:EditOpenButton({
        Title = "Flee The Facility Script",
        Icon = "gavel",
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16),
        StrokeThickness = 2,
        Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHex("#00E5FF"), Color3.fromHex("#FF2E88")),
        Draggable = true,
    })
end)

local ESPTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "ESP", Icon = "eye" })
local PlayerTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Players", Icon = "wrench" })
local BeastTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Beast", Icon = "skull" })
local SettingsTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Settings", Icon = "settings" })

-- Overlay for the Beast arrow and crawl button
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FTFScriptOverlay"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 50
if not pcall(function() gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end) or not gui.Parent then
    gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PLAYER ESP
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local espObjects = {}

local function clearESP(plr)
    local o = espObjects[plr]
    if o then
        o.hl:Destroy()
        o.bb:Destroy()
        espObjects[plr] = nil
    end
end

local function updateESP(plr, isBeast)
    if plr == lp or not flags.Players then
        return clearESP(plr)
    end

    local char = plr.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then
        return clearESP(plr)
    end

    local o = espObjects[plr]
    if o and (o.char ~= char or not o.hl.Parent or not o.bb.Parent) then
        clearESP(plr)
        o = nil
    end

    if not o then
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "BeastTag"
        bb.Adornee = head
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        bb.Parent = head

        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextSize = 26
        label.Text = "BEAST"
        label.TextColor3 = BEAST_COLOR
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.Parent = bb

        o = {hl = makeHighlight(char, "PlayerESP"), bb = bb, char = char}
        espObjects[plr] = o
    end

    setColor(o.hl, isBeast and BEAST_COLOR or PLAYER_COLOR)
    o.bb.Enabled = isBeast -- only the Beast gets a text tag
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearESP)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPUTER + POD + DOOR ESP
-- (finds objects by exact name, like the old Rayfield script)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local objects = {} -- [instance] = {kind, hl, adornee}
local lastMapName, lastScan = nil, 0

local function kindOf(inst)
    local n = inst.Name
    if n == "ComputerTable" then return "COMPUTER" end
    if n == "FreezePod" then return "POD" end
    if n:lower() == "exitdoor" then return "EXIT" end
    if n == "SingleDoor" or n == "DoubleDoor" then return "DOOR" end
end

local function adorneeFor(inst)
    -- single doors highlight only the moving "Door" part, double doors the whole model
    if inst.Name == "SingleDoor" then
        return inst:FindFirstChild("Door")
    end
    return inst
end

local function wanted(kind)
    return (kind == "COMPUTER" and flags.Computers)
        or (kind == "POD" and flags.Pods)
        or (kind == "DOOR" and flags.Doors)
        or (kind == "EXIT" and flags.ExitDoors)
end

local function clearObj(inst)
    local o = objects[inst]
    if o then
        o.hl:Destroy()
        objects[inst] = nil
    end
end

local function scanObjects()
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local kind = kindOf(d)
        if kind and wanted(kind) and not objects[d] then
            local adornee = adorneeFor(d)
            if adornee then
                objects[d] = {kind = kind, hl = makeHighlight(adornee, "ObjESP"), adornee = adornee}
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Computer is "done" when its screen turns dark green
local function isHacked(model)
    local screen = model:FindFirstChild("Screen", true)
    return screen ~= nil and screen:IsA("BasePart")
        and screen.BrickColor == BrickColor.new("Dark green")
end

-- ActionSign value: 11 = open (green), 10 = closed (red)
local function doorColor(inst)
    local trigger = inst:FindFirstChild("DoorTrigger")
    local sign = trigger and trigger:FindFirstChild("ActionSign")
    local val = sign and sign.Value
    if val == 11 then return DOOR_OPEN end
    if val == 10 then return DOOR_CLOSED end
end

local function updateObjects()
    for inst, o in pairs(objects) do
        if not wanted(o.kind) then clearObj(inst) end
    end
    if not flags.Computers and not flags.Pods and not flags.Doors and not flags.ExitDoors then return end

    local mapName = rs("CurrentMap")
    local now = os.clock()
    if mapName ~= lastMapName or now - lastScan > 5 then
        lastMapName, lastScan = mapName, now
        scanObjects()
    end

    for inst, o in pairs(objects) do
        if not inst.Parent or not o.adornee.Parent or not o.hl.Parent then
            clearObj(inst)
        elseif o.kind == "COMPUTER" then
            setColor(o.hl, isHacked(inst) and COMPUTER_DONE or COMPUTER_COLOR)
        elseif o.kind == "POD" then
            setColor(o.hl, POD_COLOR)
        elseif o.kind == "EXIT" then
            setColor(o.hl, EXIT_COLOR)
        else
            local c = doorColor(inst)
            if c then setColor(o.hl, c) end
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BEAST ARROW (automatic while Players ESP is on)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local arrow = Instance.new("Frame")
arrow.Name = "BeastArrow"
arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
arrow.Visible = false
arrow.Parent = gui

-- Arrow shape: thin shaft + a sharp triangular head (tip points up)
local HEAD_TIP_Y = 8        -- y of the very tip inside the arrow frame
local HEAD_HEIGHT = 22
local HEAD_SLOPE = 0.45     -- half-width gained per pixel down (bigger = fatter head)
local SHAFT_WIDTH = 6
local SHAFT_BOTTOM = 52
local OUTLINE = 2.5

local function rowFrame(y, width, height, color, z)
    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
    f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, y)
    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
    f.BackgroundColor3 = color
    f.BorderSizePixel = 0
    f.ZIndex = z
    f.Parent = arrow
    return f
end

-- Triangle from 1px rows (2px tall so rows overlap and leave no seams)
local function head(tipY, height, color, z)
    for i = 0, math.ceil(height) - 1 do
        rowFrame(tipY + i, 2 * HEAD_SLOPE * (i + 1), 2, color, z)
    end
end

local function shaft(topY, bottomY, width, color, z)
    local f = rowFrame(topY, width, bottomY - topY, color, z)
    Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(width / 2))
end

-- Black outline first (pushed out evenly on every side), then the red arrow on top
local sinHalf = HEAD_SLOPE / math.sqrt(1 + HEAD_SLOPE * HEAD_SLOPE)
local tipPush = OUTLINE / sinHalf
head(HEAD_TIP_Y - tipPush, HEAD_HEIGHT + tipPush + OUTLINE, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1)
shaft(HEAD_TIP_Y + HEAD_HEIGHT - 4, SHAFT_BOTTOM + OUTLINE, SHAFT_WIDTH + OUTLINE * 2, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1)

head(HEAD_TIP_Y, HEAD_HEIGHT, BEAST_COLOR, 2)
shaft(HEAD_TIP_Y + HEAD_HEIGHT - 4, SHAFT_BOTTOM, SHAFT_WIDTH, BEAST_COLOR, 2)

-- Distance readout next to the arrow
local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
distLabel.Name = "BeastDistance"
distLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
distLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 20)
distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
distLabel.TextSize = 16
distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
distLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
distLabel.Visible = false
distLabel.Parent = gui

local function hideArrow()
    arrow.Visible = false
    distLabel.Visible = false
end

local arrowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flags.Players then return hideArrow() end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local theirs = currentBeast and currentBeast ~= lp and currentBeast.Character
        and currentBeast.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (cam and theirs) then return hideArrow() end

    -- distance in studs (from you; falls back to the camera)
    local myRoot = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local from = myRoot and myRoot.Position or cam.CFrame.Position
    local studs = math.floor((theirs.Position - from).Magnitude + 0.5)

    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(theirs.Position)
    local inFront = sp.Z > 0

    -- Beast is on screen: no arrow needed
    if inFront and sp.X > ARROW_MARGIN and sp.X < viewport.X - ARROW_MARGIN
        and sp.Y > ARROW_MARGIN and sp.Y < viewport.Y - ARROW_MARGIN then
        return hideArrow()
    end

    local center = viewport / 2
    local dir = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center
    if not inFront then dir = -dir end
    if dir.Magnitude < 1 then dir = Vector2.new(0, 1) end
    dir = dir.Unit

    local tx = dir.X ~= 0 and (center.X - ARROW_MARGIN) / math.abs(dir.X) or math.huge
    local ty = dir.Y ~= 0 and (center.Y - ARROW_MARGIN) / math.abs(dir.Y) or math.huge
    local pos = center + dir * math.min(tx, ty)

    arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
    arrow.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dir.X, -dir.Y))
    arrow.Visible = true

    distLabel.Text = studs .. " studs"
    -- sit just behind the arrow's tail, clear of the text box edges
    local gap = 26 + math.abs(dir.X) * (distLabel.TextBounds.X / 2) + math.abs(dir.Y) * 9
    local lpos = pos - dir * gap
    distLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lpos.X, lpos.Y)
    distLabel.Visible = true
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BEAST DETECTION + PERK ALERT
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local notifiedBeast, notifiedPower = nil, nil

local function updateBeast(gameActive, power)
    if not gameActive then
        notifiedBeast, notifiedPower, currentBeast = nil, nil, nil
        return
    end

    currentBeast = nil
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if stat(plr, "IsBeast") == true then
            currentBeast = plr
            break
        end
    end

    local beast = currentBeast
    if not beast or not flags.BeastAlert then return end

    if notifiedBeast ~= beast.Name then
        notifiedBeast, notifiedPower = beast.Name, power
        local who = (beast == lp) and "You are the Beast" or ("Beast: " .. beast.Name)
        notify(who, "Power: " .. tostring(power or "unknown"), 8)
    elseif power and power ~= notifiedPower then
        notifiedPower = power
        notify("Beast power: " .. tostring(power), beast.Name, 8)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THIRD PERSON CAMERA
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local savedCam = nil

local function applyThirdPerson()
    if not flags.ThirdPerson then return end
    pcall(function()
        lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = THIRD_PERSON_MIN_ZOOM
        lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = THIRD_PERSON_MAX_ZOOM
    end)
end

-- Pushes the camera out once, then hands zoom back to you
local function pushOutCamera()
    if not flags.ThirdPerson then return end
    pcall(function()
        lp.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
        lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = THIRD_PERSON_MAX_ZOOM
        lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = THIRD_PERSON_START_ZOOM
    end)
    task.delay(0.2, applyThirdPerson)
end

local function setThirdPerson(on)
    flags.ThirdPerson = on
    if on then
        savedCam = savedCam or {
            mode = lp.CameraMode,
            min = lp.CameraMinZoomDistance,
            max = lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance,
        }
        pushOutCamera()
    elseif savedCam then
        pcall(function()
            lp.CameraMode = savedCam.mode
            lp.CameraMinZoomDistance = savedCam.min
            lp.CameraMaxZoomDistance = savedCam.max
        end)
        savedCam = nil
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LIGHT (soft point light on your character)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function removeLight()
    local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local light = root and root:FindFirstChild("FTFLight")
    if light then light:Destroy() end
end

local function applyLight()
    if not flags.Light then return end
    local root = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local light = root:FindFirstChild("FTFLight")
    if not light then
        light = Instance.new("PointLight")
        light.Name = "FTFLight"
        light.Shadows = false
        light.Parent = root
    end
    light.Brightness = LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS
    light.Range = LIGHT_RANGE
    light.Color = LIGHT_COLOR
end

local function setLight(on)
    flags.Light = on
    if on then applyLight() else removeLight() end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- NO FAIL ON HACK
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local noFailThread = nil

local function setNoFail(on)
    flags.NoFail = on
    if on and not noFailThread then
        noFailThread = task.spawn(function()
            while flags.NoFail and running do
                pcall(function()
                    ReplicatedStorage.RemoteEvent:FireServer("SetPlayerMinigameResult", true)
                end)
                task.wait()
            end
            noFailThread = nil
        end)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CRAWL BUTTON
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 229, 255)
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 46, 136)

local crawling = false
local crawlTrack, savedHip, savedSpeed, crawlConn
local noclipConn, noclipParts = nil, {} -- noclip only while crawling
local crawlBtn, crawlGrad, crawlStroke, crawlStrokeGrad, crawlLabel, crawlDot, crawlScale, crawlDragConn
local crawlDragged = false
local crawlLocked = false
local crawlPos = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0.6, 0) -- remembered between on/off

local function styleCrawlButton()
    if not crawlBtn then return end
    if crawling then
        crawlGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 90))
        crawlStrokeGrad.Enabled = false
        crawlStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(210, 255, 225)
        crawlLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 24, 12)
        crawlDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 24, 12)
    else
        crawlGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 44), Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 22))
        crawlStrokeGrad.Enabled = true
        crawlStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        crawlLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
        crawlDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
    end
end

local function findCrawlAnimation()
    for _, root in ipairs({ReplicatedStorage, lp.Character, lp, game:GetService("StarterPlayer")}) do
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Animation") and d.AnimationId ~= ""
                and d.Name:lower():find("crawl", 1, true) then
                return d
            end
        end
    end
end

local function stopCrawl()
    if crawlConn then crawlConn:Disconnect() crawlConn = nil end
    if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() noclipConn = nil end
    for part in pairs(noclipParts) do
        if part.Parent then part.CanCollide = true end
    end
    noclipParts = {}
    if crawlTrack then
        pcall(function() crawlTrack:Stop() end)
        crawlTrack = nil
    end
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and savedHip then hum.HipHeight = savedHip end
    if hum and savedSpeed then hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
    savedHip, savedSpeed, crawling = nil, nil, false
    styleCrawlButton()
end

local function startCrawl()
    local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    local anim = findCrawlAnimation()
    if not anim then
        return notify("Crawl", "No crawl animation found in this game.", 5)
    end

    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
    local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if not ok or not track then
        return notify("Crawl", "Couldn't load the crawl animation.", 5)
    end

    track.Looped = true
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play()
    crawlTrack = track

    savedHip, savedSpeed = hum.HipHeight, hum.WalkSpeed
    hum.WalkSpeed = CRAWL_SPEED

    -- Keep the body pulled down to the floor (R6 and R15)
    crawlConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = lp.Character
        local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h or not root or h.Health <= 0 then return end

        if h.WalkSpeed ~= CRAWL_SPEED then h.WalkSpeed = CRAWL_SPEED end

        -- sync the animation to how fast you're actually moving
        if crawlTrack then
            local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local moving = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
            crawlTrack:AdjustSpeed(moving > 0.5 and math.clamp(moving / CRAWL_ANIM_REF_SPEED, 0.3, 2) or 0)
        end
        if h.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then return end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), params)
        if not hit then return end

        local err = CRAWL_HEIGHT - (root.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y)
        if math.abs(err) > 0.05 then
            h.HipHeight = math.clamp(h.HipHeight + err * 0.3, -8, math.max(savedHip or 0, 2))
        end
    end)

    -- Noclip while crawling so you can fit through vents
    noclipParts = {}
    noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local c = lp.Character
        if not c then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.CanCollide then
                noclipParts[d] = true
                d.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)

    crawling = true
    styleCrawlButton()
    hum.Died:Once(stopCrawl)
end

local function createCrawlButton()
    if crawlBtn then return end

    -- Invisible hit area (takes the taps / drags)
    crawlBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    crawlBtn.Name = "CrawlButton"
    crawlBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 46)
    crawlBtn.Position = crawlPos
    crawlBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    crawlBtn.Text = ""
    crawlBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    crawlBtn.Parent = gui

    crawlScale = Instance.new("UIScale", crawlBtn)

    -- Visual layer
    local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
    bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bg.Parent = crawlBtn
    Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    crawlGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", bg)
    crawlGrad.Rotation = 90

    crawlStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", bg)
    crawlStroke.Thickness = 2.5
    crawlStrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", crawlStroke)

    crawlLabel.TextSize = 17
    crawlLabel.Text = "CRAWL"
    crawlLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    crawlLabel.Parent = bg

    styleCrawlButton()

    crawlBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        if crawlDragged then
            crawlDragged = false -- that was a drag, not a tap
            return
        end
        if stat(lp, "IsBeast") ~= true then
            return notify("Beast Crawl", "Wait till you're the Beast!", 4)
        end
        if not crawlLocked then
            return notify("Beast Crawl", "Lock crawl button before using crawl!", 4)
        end
        if crawling then stopCrawl() else startCrawl() end
    end)

    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    crawlBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            crawlScale.Scale = 0.94 -- press effect
            crawlDragged = false
            if not crawlLocked then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = crawlBtn.Position
            end
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    if crawlScale then crawlScale.Scale = 1 end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    crawlDragConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and not crawlLocked and crawlBtn
            and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            if d.Magnitude > 6 then crawlDragged = true end
            if crawlDragged then
                crawlPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                crawlBtn.Position = crawlPos
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function destroyCrawlButton()
    stopCrawl()
    if crawlDragConn then crawlDragConn:Disconnect() crawlDragConn = nil end
    if crawlBtn then
        crawlBtn:Destroy()
        crawlBtn = nil
    end
    crawlDragged = false
end

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if crawlConn then crawlConn:Disconnect() crawlConn = nil end

    elseif char then

    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------

    updateObjects()
    applyThirdPerson() -- re-applies in case the game resets the camera
    applyLight()       -- re-applies in case the light gets removed
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

    end
end

    while running do
        local ok, err = pcall(refresh)
        if not ok then warn("Flee The Facility Script error: " .. tostring(err)) end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local function refreshNow()

end

--------------------------------------------------------------------

        tweenOut.Completed:Connect(function() notifGui:Destroy() end)
    end
    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeNotif)
    task.delay(25, function() if notifGui and notifGui.Parent then closeNotif() end end)
end

    if noclipActive then
        local c = getChar()
        for _, v in pairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end end
    end
end

local function getPartFromPath(path)
    if not path then return nil end
    local current = game
    for _, partName in pairs(string.split(path, ".")) do
        if current then current = current:FindFirstChild(partName) end
    end
    return current
end

local function teleportToSpot(spotKey)
    local spot = SPOTS[spotKey]
    if not spot or not spot.path then return end
    
    local part = getPartFromPath(spot.path)
    if part then
        local targetCFrame = part.CFrame
        local root = getRoot()
        
        root.CFrame = targetCFrame
        root.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        
        local startTime = tick()
        local connection
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if tick() - startTime < 2 then
                if (root.Position - targetCFrame.Position).Magnitude > 5 then
                    root.CFrame = targetCFrame
                end
            else
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
        
        task.spawn(function() 
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "By Alo's", 
                Text = "Teleported to " .. spot.name .. "!", 
                Duration = 3
            }) 
        end)
    else
        task.spawn(function() 
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "By Alo's", 
                Text = "Spot not found, This is for " .. spot.game .. " btw", 
                Duration = 3

    end

	return nil

	if not interactItemFunc then
		setStatus("InteractItem remote not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))

	local towerName = textBox.Text

		setStatus("Tower '" .. towerName .. "' not found.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end

		setStatus("GetData remote not found!", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
		return
	end
	local playerData = getDataFunc:InvokeServer()
	if not playerData then
		setStatus("Could not fetch player data.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))

	end

	-- Check if already owned
	if table.find(playerData.OwnedTowers, towerName) then
		setStatus("You already own this tower.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0))
		return
	end

	-- Attempt purchase via InteractItem (stars check skipped)

		starsLabel.Text = "Stars: \226\152\133" .. tostring(result.Stars)
		setStatus("Successfully bought " .. towerName .. "!", Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100))
		textBox.Text = ""
	else
		setStatus("Purchase failed.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100))
	end
end

	refreshStars()

refreshStars()

local function partPosition(rig, name, edge)
    local part = rig.Parts[name]
    if not part then return nil end
    if edge == "top" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    if edge == "bottom" then return part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -part.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    return part.Position
end

local function resolvePoint(rig, key)
    local kind, name = key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
    if not kind then return nil end
    if kind == "joint" then return jointPosition(rig, name) end
    if kind == "top" or kind == "bottom" then return partPosition(rig, name, kind) end
    if kind == "center" then return partPosition(rig, name) end
    return nil
end

local function getBones(rig)
    if rig.Humanoid and rig.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then return R15Bones end
    return R6Bones
end

    for _, key in ipairs(extras) do

    end

    for _, key in ipairs(extras) do
        if entry[key] then entry[key].Visible = false end
    end
end

local function project(camera, position)
    if not position then return nil end
    local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
    if point.Z <= 0 then return nil end
    return Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y), point.Z
end

local function getTracerOrigin(camera)
    local origin = Config.TracerOrigin
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    if origin == "Bottom" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
    elseif origin == "Top" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, 0)
    elseif origin == "Center" then return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    elseif origin == "Mouse" then
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        return Vector2.new(m.X, m.Y)
    end
    return Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
end

local function shouldDraw(player, localRoot)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if Config.TeamCheck and isTeammate(player) then return false end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    if localRoot and (root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude > Config.MaxDistance then
        return false
    end
    return true, char, hum, root
end

local function computeBounds(rig, camera)
    local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local boneList = getBones(rig)
    for _, bone in ipairs(boneList) do
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local pos = resolvePoint(rig, bone[i])
            if pos then
                local screenPos = project(camera, pos)
                if screenPos then
                    minX = math.min(minX, screenPos.X)
                    maxX = math.max(maxX, screenPos.X)
                    minY = math.min(minY, screenPos.Y)
                    maxY = math.max(maxY, screenPos.Y)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if minX == math.huge then return nil end
    local padding = 4
    return {
        minX = minX - padding, maxX = maxX + padding,
        minY = minY - padding, maxY = maxY + padding,
    }
end

local function updatePlayer(player, entry, camera, localRoot, rainbowColor)
    if not camera then hideAll(entry) return end
    local ok, char, hum, root = shouldDraw(player, localRoot)
    if not ok then hideAll(entry) return end

    if not entry.Rig or entry.Rig.Character ~= char then
        entry.Rig = buildRig(char)
    end
    local rig = entry.Rig
    if not rig.Parts.Head or not rig.Parts.HumanoidRootPart then
        entry.Rig = buildRig(char)
        rig = entry.Rig
    end

    local boneColor = Config.SkeletonRainbow and rainbowColor or Config.SkeletonColor
    local boxColor = Config.BoxRainbow and rainbowColor or Config.BoxColor

    if Config.SkeletonEnabled and Config.Enabled then
        local bones = getBones(rig)
        for index, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do
            local bone = bones[index]
            if bone then
                local a = resolvePoint(rig, bone[1])
                local b = resolvePoint(rig, bone[2])
                local pa = project(camera, a)
                local pb = project(camera, b)
                if pa and pb then
                    line.From = pa
                    line.To = pb
                    line.Color = boneColor
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    line.Visible = false
                end
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        end
    else
        for _, line in ipairs(entry.Lines) do line.Visible = false end
    end

    local bounds = computeBounds(rig, camera)

    if Config.BoxEnabled and Config.Enabled and bounds and entry.Box then
        local tl = Vector2.new(bounds.minX, bounds.minY)
        local br = Vector2.new(bounds.maxX, bounds.maxY)
        entry.Box.Size = br - tl
        entry.Box.Position = tl
        entry.Box.Color = boxColor
        entry.Box.Thickness = Config.BoxThickness
        entry.Box.Transparency = Config.BoxTransparency
        entry.Box.Visible = true
        if Config.BoxFill and entry.BoxFill then
            entry.BoxFill.Size = br - tl
            entry.BoxFill.Position = tl
            entry.BoxFill.Color = boxColor
            entry.BoxFill.Transparency = Config.BoxFillTransparency
            entry.BoxFill.Visible = true
        elseif entry.BoxFill then
            entry.BoxFill.Visible = false
        end
    else
        if entry.Box then entry.Box.Visible = false end
        if entry.BoxFill then entry.BoxFill.Visible = false end
    end

    if Config.Tracers and Config.Enabled and entry.Tracer then
        local headPoint = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "top"))
        if headPoint then
            entry.Tracer.From = getTracerOrigin(camera)
            entry.Tracer.To = headPoint
            entry.Tracer.Color = Config.TracerColor
            entry.Tracer.Thickness = Config.TracerThickness
            entry.Tracer.Transparency = Config.TracerTransparency
            entry.Tracer.Visible = true
        else
            entry.Tracer.Visible = false
        end
    elseif entry.Tracer then
        entry.Tracer.Visible = false
    end

    local headTop = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "top"))
    local headBottom = project(camera, partPosition(rig, "Head", "bottom"))

    if Config.NameEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.NameText and headTop then
        entry.NameText.Text = player.Name
        entry.NameText.Position = Vector2.new(headTop.X, headTop.Y - Config.NameSize - 6)
        entry.NameText.Color = Config.NameColor
        entry.NameText.Size = Config.NameSize
        entry.NameText.Outline = Config.NameOutline
        entry.NameText.Visible = true
    elseif entry.NameText then
        entry.NameText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.DistanceEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.DistText and headBottom then
        local dist = localRoot and math.floor((root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude) or 0
        entry.DistText.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
        entry.DistText.Position = Vector2.new(headBottom.X, headBottom.Y + 4)
        entry.DistText.Color = Config.DistanceColor
        entry.DistText.Size = Config.DistanceSize
        entry.DistText.Visible = true
    elseif entry.DistText then
        entry.DistText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.HealthEnabled and Config.Enabled and bounds and entry.HealthBar and entry.HealthBg then
        local ratio = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
        local barX = bounds.minX - Config.HealthOffset
        local topY = bounds.minY
        local botY = bounds.maxY
        local fillBotY = botY - (botY - topY) * ratio
        entry.HealthBg.From = Vector2.new(barX, topY)
        entry.HealthBg.To   = Vector2.new(barX, botY)
        entry.HealthBg.Visible = Config.HealthBackground
        entry.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(barX, fillBotY)
        entry.HealthBar.To   = Vector2.new(barX, botY)
        entry.HealthBar.Color = healthColor(ratio)
        entry.HealthBar.Thickness = Config.HealthWidth
        entry.HealthBar.Visible = true
    else
        if entry.HealthBar then entry.HealthBar.Visible = false end
        if entry.HealthBg then entry.HealthBg.Visible = false end
    end

    if Config.ToolEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.ToolText and headBottom then
        local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            entry.ToolText.Text = tool.Name
            entry.ToolText.Position = Vector2.new(headBottom.X, headBottom.Y + Config.DistanceSize + 6)
            entry.ToolText.Color = Config.ToolColor
            entry.ToolText.Size = Config.ToolSize
            entry.ToolText.Visible = true
        else
            entry.ToolText.Visible = false
        end
    elseif entry.ToolText then
        entry.ToolText.Visible = false
    end

    if Config.HeadDotEnabled and Config.Enabled and entry.HeadCircle and headTop and headBottom then
        local center = (headTop + headBottom) * 0.5
        local radius = math.max((headTop - headBottom).Magnitude * 0.5, 3)
        entry.HeadCircle.Position = center
        entry.HeadCircle.Radius = radius + Config.HeadDotSize
        entry.HeadCircle.Color = Config.HeadDotColor
        entry.HeadCircle.Filled = Config.HeadDotFilled
        entry.HeadCircle.Visible = true
    elseif entry.HeadCircle then
        entry.HeadCircle.Visible = false
    end
end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(targetChar, targetPart)
    local part = targetChar:FindFirstChild(targetPart)
    if not part then return false end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = part.Position - origin
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params) == nil
end

local function getPredictedPosition(part, prediction)
    if not part then return nil end
    if prediction <= 0 then return part.Position end
    return part.Position + (part.Velocity * prediction)
end

local aimLastTarget = nil
local aimLastTargetTime = 0

local function aimbotIsValid(char)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not hum or not part or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if plr and Config.TeamCheck and isTeammate(plr) then return false end
    return true
end

local function aimbotScore(char)
    local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not part then return nil end
    local predicted = getPredictedPosition(part, Config.AimbotPrediction)
    if not predicted then return nil end
    local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, predicted)
    if not screenPos or depth <= 0 then return nil end
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local dist = (screenPos - center).Magnitude
    if dist > Config.AimbotFOV then return nil end
    if Config.AimbotVisibleOnly then
        if not isVisibleFromCamera(char, Config.AimbotPart) then return nil end
    elseif Config.AimbotWallCheck then
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = part.Position - origin
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, char}
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
        if result and result.Instance and not result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char) then return nil end
    end
    return dist
end

local function aimbotSelectTarget()
    local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
    for _, char in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if char:IsA("Model") and char ~= LocalPlayer.Character and aimbotIsValid(char) then
            local score = aimbotScore(char)
            if score and score < bestScore then best, bestScore = char, score end
        end
    end
    local now = tick()
    if best then
        aimLastTarget = best
        aimLastTargetTime = now
        return best
    end
    if aimLastTarget and (now - aimLastTargetTime) < Config.AimbotStickyTime then
        if aimLastTarget.Parent and aimbotIsValid(aimLastTarget) then
            local part = aimLastTarget:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
            if part then
                local screenPos, depth = project(Camera, part.Position)
                if screenPos and depth > 0 then
                    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                    if (screenPos - center).Magnitude <= Config.AimbotFOV * 1.25 then
                        return aimLastTarget
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        aimLastTarget = nil
    end
    return nil
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Config.AimbotEnabled then return end
    local target = aimbotSelectTarget()
    if not target then return end
    local part = target:FindFirstChild(Config.AimbotPart)
    if not part then return end
    local predicted = getPredictedPosition(part, Config.AimbotPrediction)
    if not predicted then return end
    local targetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, predicted)
    local screenPos = project(Camera, predicted)
    if screenPos then
        local delta = (screenPos - Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)).Magnitude
        if delta < Config.AimbotDeadzone then return end
    end
    local jitter = Vector3.new(
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        (math.random() - 0.5) * Config.AimbotJitter,
        0
    )
    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame * CFrame.new(jitter), Config.AimbotSmoothness)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

if getgenv().WideOpen_CleanUp then
    pcall(getgenv().WideOpen_CleanUp)
end

getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip = true

-- 1. Hook / Neutralize CrashWalls (Prevents invisible CrashCar hitboxes)
local CrashWalls = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.CrashWalls)
if not getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars then
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars = CrashWalls.Cars
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Sweep = CrashWalls.Sweep
    getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_new = CrashWalls.new
end

CrashWalls.Cars = function(self, ...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        if self and self.ClearCars then
            pcall(self.ClearCars, self)
        end
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Cars(self, ...)
end

CrashWalls.Sweep = function(self, ...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_CrashWalls_Sweep(self, ...)
end

-- 2. Hook / Neutralize TrafficContact
local TrafficContact = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TrafficContact)
if not getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep then
    getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep = TrafficContact.Sweep
    getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Test = TrafficContact.Test
end

TrafficContact.Sweep = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return nil, math.huge, 0, 1
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Sweep(...)
end

TrafficContact.Test = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return nil, math.huge, 0
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_TrafficContact_Test(...)
end

-- 3. Hook / Neutralize ParkedVehicleContact
local ParkedContact = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ParkedVehicleContact)
if not getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne then
    getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne = ParkedContact.ResolveOne
    getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_Resolve = ParkedContact.Resolve
end

ParkedContact.ResolveOne = function(cf, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return maxPos, vel, false
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_ResolveOne(cf, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
end

ParkedContact.Resolve = function(lastPos, pos, look, vel, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return pos, vel, false
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_ParkedContact_Resolve(lastPos, pos, look, vel, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
end

-- 4. Hook / Neutralize Police Contact
local PalmPolice = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.PalmBeachPoliceContact)
if not getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_ResolveOne then
    getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_ResolveOne = PalmPolice.ResolveOne
    getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_step = PalmPolice.step
end

PalmPolice.ResolveOne = function(cf1, cf2, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, unit, linVel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return maxPos, linVel, false, 0, Vector3.zero
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_ResolveOne(cf1, cf2, size, minPos, maxPos, vel, unit, linVel, dt, scale, halfW, halfL, lowestOffset)
end

PalmPolice.step = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_PalmPolice_step(...)
end

local HighwayPolice = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.HighwayPoliceContact)

end

HighwayPolice.step = function(...)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
        return
    end
    return getgenv().Orig_HighwayPolice_step(...)
end

-- 5. Hook / Neutralize RideState Crash calls
local RideState = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.RideState)
if not getgenv().Orig_RideState_BeginCrash then
    getgenv().Orig_RideState_BeginCrash = RideState.BeginCrash
end

RideState.BeginCrash = function(cause, extra)
    if getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip and (cause == "traffic" or cause == "police" or cause == "car" or cause == "wall" or cause == nil) then
        return false
    end
    if getgenv().Orig_RideState_BeginCrash then
        return getgenv().Orig_RideState_BeginCrash(cause, extra)
    end
    return false
end

-- 6. Hook Namecall (FireServer blocking)
local namecallHook
if hookmetamethod then
    namecallHook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if not checkcaller() and method == "FireServer" and getgenv().WideOpen_Noclip then
            local name = self.Name
            if name == "ReportContact" or name == "HighwayCopHit" or name == "ReportCityCrash" then
                return
            end
            if name == "CrashRagdoll" then
                local args = {...}
                if args[1] == "start" and (args[2] == "traffic" or args[2] == "police" or args[2] == "car" or args[2] == "wall") then
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        return namecallHook(self, ...)
    end)
end

-- 7. Hook RemoteEvent OnClientEvent (CrashEvent intercept)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
local crashEvent = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CrashEvent")
if crashEvent and not getgenv().CrashEventHooked then

    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do

            for _, c in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("BasePart") and c.CanCollide then
                    c.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local traffic = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Traffic")
    if traffic then
        for _, car in ipairs(traffic:GetChildren()) do
            for _, part in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local proxy = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TrafficProxy")
    if proxy then
        for _, part in ipairs(proxy:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    local activeBikes = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ActiveBikes")
    if activeBikes then
        for _, b in ipairs(activeBikes:GetChildren()) do
            if b:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == LocalPlayer.UserId or string.find(b.Name, LocalPlayer.Name) then
                if not b:GetAttribute("NFNC_Ghost") then

                end
                for _, part in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "chassis_chassis" and part.CanCollide then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 9. Custom GUI

--[[
	PORTAL (primera persona) - MÓVIL
	Colócalo como LocalScript en: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

	- Fuerza la primera persona.
	- Muestra la pistola de portales y la vida (HEALTH) como en el videojuego.
	- Los portales se crean en la superficie a la que apuntas (pared, suelo o techo).
	  Si no apuntas a nada, usa la superficie más cercana a ti.
	- Conserva el impulso: si caes por un portal del suelo, sales con esa velocidad.
	- Los botones están junto al botón de saltar.
	- Solo tú los ves y usas (LocalScript).
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function castParams()
	local p = RaycastParams.new()

	return p
end

local function camFlat()
	local l = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local f = Vector3.new(l.X, 0, l.Z)
	return f.Magnitude > 0.01 and f.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)

---------------------------------------------------------------------

local gunFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
gunFolder.Name = "PortalGun"
gunFolder.Parent = fx

local function addGunPart(size, rel, color, material, shape)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	if shape then p.Shape = shape end
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false

	table.insert(gunParts, { part = p, rel = rel })

end

local white = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 242)

	Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
addGunPart(Vector3.new(0.1, 0.46, 0.46), CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.7) * A(0, math.pi / 2, 0), silver,
	Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
for _, o in { Vector3.new(0.19, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(-0.19, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.2, 0) } do
	addGunPart(Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.75), CFrame.new(o.X, o.Y, -1.0), silver, Enum.Material.Metal)
end

	Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)

local recoil, tipColor = 0, COLORS.A

RunService:BindToRenderStep("PortalGunViewmodel", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	recoil = math.max(0, recoil - dt * 5)
	local speed = 0
	if root then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		speed = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
	end
	local bob = math.min(speed / 16, 1)
	local t = os.clock()
	local off = CFrame.new(0.8 + math.sin(t * 6) * 0.03 * bob,
		-0.75 + math.abs(math.cos(t * 6)) * 0.04 * bob, -1.4 + recoil * 0.35)
		* A(recoil * 0.25, -0.05, 0)
	local base = camera.CFrame * off
	for _, g in gunParts do g.part.CFrame = base * g.rel end
	tip.Color, strip.Color = tipColor, tipColor

	-- HUD de vida
	if humanoid then
		local hp = humanoid.Health
		hudNum.Text = (hp >= 1e6) and "∞" or tostring(math.max(0, math.ceil(hp)))

		hudNum.TextColor3 = low and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 40) or ORANGE
		hudLabel.TextColor3 = hudNum.TextColor3
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CREAR PORTALES
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function buildPortal(key, cf)
	if portals[key] then portals[key].model:Destroy() end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Portal" .. key
	model.Parent = fx
	local color = COLORS[key]

	local function makeCylinder(fullSize, c, transparency)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		p.Size = Vector3.new(fullSize.X, 0.1, 0.1)
		p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		p.Color = c
		p.Transparency = transparency
		p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
		p.CFrame = cf * A(0, math.pi / 2, 0) -- el eje del cilindro mira hacia la normal de la superficie
		p.Parent = model
		TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = fullSize }):Play()
		return p
	end

	makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.2, H + 0.8, W + 0.8), color, 0.05) -- aro brillante
	local disc = makeCylinder(Vector3.new(0.35, H, W), color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.55), 0.35)

	local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Color = ColorSequence.new(color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	e.LightEmission = 1
	e.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
	e.Rate = 45
	e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 2)
	e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-120, 120)
	e.Parent = disc

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = color
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Range = 14
	light.Parent = disc

	portals[key] = { model = model, cf = cf }

end

-- Marco del portal sobre una superficie (pared, suelo o techo)
local function surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	pos = pos + normal * 0.06
	local up = Vector3.yAxis
	if math.abs(normal.Y) > 0.7 then
		up = camFlat() -- en suelo/techo el eje largo del portal sigue tu mirada, como en Portal
	else
		local g = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), castParams())
		if g and pos.Y - H / 2 < g.Position.Y then
			pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, g.Position.Y + H / 2 + 0.1, pos.Z)
		end
	end
	return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + normal, up)
end

-- Superficie a la que apuntas; si no hay, la más cercana a ti
local function findSurface()
	local params = castParams()
	local vp = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(vp.X, vp.Y)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 250, params)
	if hit then return hit.Position, hit.Normal end

	local best
	for _, d in { Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis } do
		local h = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, d * 60, params)
		if h and (not best or h.Distance < best.Distance) then best = h end
	end
	if best then return best.Position, best.Normal end
end

local function shootBall(from, to, color, onHit)
	local b = Instance.new("Part")
	b.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	b.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)
	b.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	b.Color = color
	b.Anchored, b.CanCollide, b.CanTouch, b.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	b.Position = from
	b.Parent = fx
	local dur = math.clamp((to - from).Magnitude / 250, 0.05, 0.4)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = to })
	tw.Completed:Connect(function()
		b:Destroy()
		onHit()
	end)
	tw:Play()
end

local function fire(key)
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end
	local pos, normal = findSurface()
	if not pos then
		say("No hay ninguna superficie cerca")
		return
	end
	tipColor = COLORS[key]
	recoil = 1
	local cf = surfaceFrame(pos, normal)
	shootBall(tip.Position, pos, COLORS[key], function() buildPortal(key, cf) end)
end

local function clearPortals()
	for key, data in portals do
		data.model:Destroy()
		portals[key] = nil
	end
	refreshCross()
	say("Portales borrados")
end

btnA.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("A") end)
btnB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() fire("B") end)
btnClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(clearPortals)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TELETRANSPORTE (detección local: solo tú puedes entrar)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local lastTp, armed = 0, true

-- ¿Está tu personaje dentro de la zona de entrada del portal?
local function inside(data)
	local rel = data.cf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	if (rel.X / (W / 2)) ^ 2 + (rel.Y / (H / 2)) ^ 2 > 1 then return false end
	local d = -rel.Z -- distancia hacia fuera de la superficie
	local n = data.cf.LookVector
	if math.abs(n.Y) > 0.7 then
		if n.Y > 0 then return d < 4.3 and d > -1.5 end -- suelo: pisarlo
		return d < 3.3 and d > -1.5 -- techo: saltar hacia él
	end
	return math.abs(d) < 1.3 -- pared
end

local function teleport(from, to)
	lastTp = os.clock()
	local nOut = to.cf.LookVector

	-- Velocidad: del portal de entrada al de salida (giro de 180°)
	local vl = from.cf:VectorToObjectSpace(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
	vl = Vector3.new(-vl.X, vl.Y, -vl.Z)
	local vOut = to.cf:VectorToWorldSpace(vl)
	local minOut = (math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7) and 22 or 14
	local outSpeed = vOut:Dot(nOut)
	if outSpeed < minOut then vOut += nOut * (minOut - outSpeed) end

	-- Posición de salida
	local pos
	if math.abs(nOut.Y) > 0.7 then
		pos = to.cf.Position + nOut * 3.4
	else
		local flatOut = Vector3.new(nOut.X, 0, nOut.Z).Unit
		pos = to.cf.Position + flatOut * 2.4
		pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, to.cf.Position.Y - H / 2 + 3.2, pos.Z)
	end

	-- Giro de la cámara (para que mires hacia fuera del portal de salida)
	local rotMap = to.cf.Rotation * A(0, math.pi, 0) * from.cf.Rotation:Inverse()
	local newLook = rotMap * camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local camHeight = camera.CFrame.Position.Y - root.Position.Y

	local flat = Vector3.new(newLook.X, 0, newLook.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = camFlat() end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + flat.Unit)
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vOut
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	local camPos = pos + Vector3.new(0, camHeight, 0)
	pcall(function() camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + newLook) end)
	flash()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end

	local hitKey
	for key, data in portals do
		if inside(data) then
			hitKey = key
			break
		end
	end
	if not hitKey then
		armed = true -- te has alejado: vuelve a activarse
		return
	end
	if not armed or os.clock() - lastTp < 0.4 then return end

	local other = portals[hitKey == "A" and "B" or "A"]
	if other then
		armed = false
		teleport(portals[hitKey], other)
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PERSONAJE / REAPARICIÓN
---------------------------------------------------------------------

	humanoid = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
